source: instances/runtime-rooted/express-b7-casterror-500.json (patch reconstructed from gold_patch; original in neat-agent-bench/patches/B7.patch)
size_rationale: Small because the one-line fix is in the login endpoint's own service function (loginUserWithEmailAndPassword), which the prompt points at by naming POST /v1/auth/login, and the getUserById(email) call is visibly wrong on reading, with no runtime information needed.
prompt: POST /v1/auth/login returns 500 for valid credentials (not the expected 401 for bad ones).

root_cause.detail: loginUserWithEmailAndPassword calls userService.getUserById(email) instead of getUserByEmail(email); findById casts the email to an ObjectId and rejects with a CastError. Note: errorConverter maps Mongoose errors to 400, so under NODE_ENV=test or development the response is 400; the 500 in the prompt is what NODE_ENV=production returns (non-operational error masked as 500).

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/login > should return 200 and login user if email and password match
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js -t 'should return 200 and login user if email and password match'
